sheets.noticed: Dark chalkboard. A NaOH burette and an acid + phenolphthalein beaker appear with a chalk title. Tidy, but the words are doing most of the work. Still in.
Same diagram, the title rewrites itself as 'into the acid'. Nothing moves in the glassware yet. Still in, a little slow.
Title changes to 'with a few drops of indicator'. The beaker still looks the same. Still in, waiting for something to happen.
A tiny yellow drip appears at the burette tip. It is the first real motion, so it holds me. Still in.
Drips come faster and the word 'pink' appears next to the beaker. Small, but there is a bit of movement. Still in.
The 'pink' is only a small grey word beside the flask. The flask never changes color, so the promise of pink is not shown. Getting thin, still in for now.
'Then it fades as you swirl', with a faint 'down' fading in. Still no real color on screen. Marginal.
Still a flat chalkboard. The flask never turns pink, 'pink' is just a word, and the text is doing all the work. I would swipe here.
